node.intro: Runs only this node, with the variables you choose. It runs like in a debug run: never live, nothing is published, nobody is notified.
node.newNode: Save the process once before you run this new node.
node.sampleHint: No passwords or keys – use a secret input or a platform's credentials instead.

answerHint.offline: Nothing is contacted. Requests need a pasted answer.
answerHint.recorded: The platform's recorded responses answer, or a pasted answer.
answerHint.live: The request is really sent – only reads (GET, HEAD, queries, AI calls, browser steps without clicks).

reason.needsRun: Recorded and live answers need the right to run this process.
reason.writes: This node writes. You can only run it with recorded answers.
reason.interacts: This browser step clicks or types. It cannot run as a live read.
reason.noPlatform: This node calls no platform. Run it offline.
reason.needsAnswer: Offline, this node needs a pasted answer or a sample answer.
reason.needsRecording: This node needs its platform. Run it with recorded answers.

node.pasteHint: Used only for this run, never stored as a recording.
node.simulatedHint: No task is created and nobody is asked. The step is marked simulated.

panel.title: Step through
panel.signalFailed: The debug run did not take the signal
panel.notStarted: The debug run did not start
panel.intro: Runs the saved version v{{version}} and pauses before the nodes you choose. Unsaved changes are not used.

modeHint.test: The platforms' recorded responses answer; nothing is sent.
modeHint.dry: Reads are sent, writes are skipped.

panel.recordedFrom: A decision was simulated at {{key}}: from there on, only recorded answers are used.
panel.notYours: Only the person who started this debug run can drive it.
panel.remainingHint: The run is stopped when the pause times out
panel.simulatedHint: Your answer is simulated: no task, nobody notified. From here on only recorded answers are used.
panel.previewHint: $now(), $uuid() and the like may give another value when the node runs.

run.compareLastGood: Compare with the last good run
run.note: A debug run: it published nothing, raised no alerts, created no tasks and notified nobody. It is kept for a few days.
run.recordedFrom: From {{key}} on it used recorded answers only.

compare.title: Compare runs
compare.emptyText: Open a run and choose “Compare with another run”, or “Compare with the last good run” on a failed one.
compare.cut: Only the first 2,000 steps are compared.
compare.hint: Compared from the stored protocol: secrets stay masked, nothing is fetched again. Open a step to see its variables.
